tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the available balance (USD) of the account that owns the current API key, plus this key's spending-limit usage.

tools.name: get_key_info
tools.description: Get the current API key's name, plan group, spending limit, concurrency limit, expiration time and status.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the models the current API key can call, with the effective price (after the key's group rate and any user-specific pricing). Check this before choosing a model; call models through the protocol-compatible endpoints, not MCP.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get request count, token count and billed cost for the current API key (last 7 days by default, up to 92 days), filterable by date range and model. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the HopBase integration docs and return the best-matching pages with URL and snippet. Use before writing integration code or when an API call fails: search model IDs, endpoint paths, parameter names or error codes/messages. Read-only; results come from the published docs and can lag a release

tools.name: get_model_limits
tools.description: For one model ID: whether this API key can call it (and via which platform), plus the endpoints, request parameters (required/optional, type, bounds, defaults) and limits documented for it, as verbatim docs excerpts with links. Best-effort: the linked docs pages are authoritative. Call list_models f
